name: borneol + camphor (synthetic) + menthol
uses: Use Target User: for sub healthy people with discomfort caused by neck, shoulder,waist and leg.
otcwarn: Do not use When using this product ■ use only as directed ■ do not bandage tighty or use with a heating pad ■ avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes ■ do not apply to wounds or damaged, broken or imitated skin ■ do not use at the same time as other topical analgesics Ask Doctor Stop use and ask doctor if: ■ rash, itching or excessive skin irritation develops ■ condition worsens ■ symptoms persist for more than 7 days ■ symptoms clear up and occur again within a few days If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a health professional before use ■ Keep out of reach of children ■ If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away Stop Use Stop use and ask doctor if: ■ rash, itching or excessive skin irritation develops ■ condition worsens ■ symptoms persist for more than 7 days ■ symptoms clear up and occur again within a few days If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a health professional before use ■ Keep out of reach of children ■ If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away
